$comment: Consumed by .github/workflows/hf-kernel-publish.yml via scripts/szl_kernel_publish.py. This repository is the single source of the Hub kernel repo SZLHOLDINGS/szl-blocked and the only writer of it and of its model-repo twin. Kernel major (version) is the v<major> API channel, not the release semver.

kernels.name: szl-blocked
kernels.$why_prune_paths: Hub-only plates seen on kernel main 3be2b2a7 (2026-10-13): OPERATIONAL.json and BENCH.laptop-blackwell.json are 2026-08-29 laptop plates that advertise revision="main" with kernels 0.16.1; SZL_SOURCE_BINDING.json is the retired runtime lane's binding, superseded by SZL_KERNEL_SOURCE.json.

model_twin.$why_prune_paths: Seen on model main 1bfc449f (2026-10-13). build/ and torch-ext/ are never loaded by kernels>=0.16 (its torch-cpu variant even lacked szl_euaiact); the plates and binding are the same stale files as on the kernel repo; scripts/ and build.toml are stale code/config copies that differ from GitHub; model.joblib stays quarantined (absent today, kept absent). BOM, receipts, provenance, SECURITY.md, LICENSE and the banner are kept.
